no_drift_guard: Mission is to discover public GitHub repositories across flash loans, flash-loan liquidation, DeFi liquidators, lending protocols, arbitrage, MEV and adjacent infrastructure.
For each repository, determine actual purpose, what code does, completeness, correctness, security, economics, tests, dependencies and license from commit-pinned evidence.
Mission Form is the primary user interface; no manual prompting of individual agents as the normal workflow.
Taxonomy-driven discovery is one stage of the autonomous swarm, never the final product.
Do not claim all public repositories have been found; quantify search coverage and API/indexing limitations.
Candidate code is never executed; no wallets, keys, signing, deployment, broadcast or live trading.
No paid services or paid inference fallback; model-dependent work blocks explicitly if free local inference is unavailable.
All material findings require source provenance and independent review before accepted.
The 7,901 candidate count is discovery only, not 7,901 audited/working bots; 10 query templates remain incomplete.
Do not call the system end-to-end autonomous until bounded candidate import, dossier synthesis and retry-safe continuation are implemented and verified.
